name: Count Limited
summary: Count Limited provides accounting, business advisory, and financial planning services in Australia. It operates through Equity Partnerships, Wealth, and Services segments. The Equity Partnerships segment offers accounting, audit and assurance, taxation, financial planning, and business and corporate advisory services. The Wealth segment provides financial services and investment products provided by Australian Financial Services license holders. The Service segment offers services that support the accounting and financial planning firms. It provides training, finance and lending, digital and IT systems, and support services.
